claims.head: Pettersson (#40) gets company tonight
claims.call: The Islanders’ L4 (Pageau, Duclair and Holmström) spends at least 43% of its 5-on-5 time against the Canucks’ second line.
claims.body: At home, the Islanders keep sending Holmström’s line (Pageau, Duclair and Holmström) out against opponents’ second lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Peter DeBoer has been using this group as a checking line on opponents’ second lines. Tonight the Canucks’ second line is DeBrusk, Pettersson (#40) and Lekkerimäki.

claims.gist: At home, Peter DeBoer likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Canucks’ second line.

NYI.head: This one sets up well for the Islanders
NYI.body: The Islanders have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage. It’s on the Canucks to make it a game, and they can if they get good looks.

VAN.head: The Canucks have their work cut out
VAN.body: The Islanders have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage. The Canucks can still win it if they get good looks, but a lot has to go their way.
